title: 221K views · 1.2K reactions | The aircraft lineup just keeps getting bigger. ✈️ MAX POWER, a new aerospace expo, is set for Nov. 7-8 at NASA's Kennedy Space Center in Florida. The event features flyovers and static displays, including NASA's F-15, F-18, T-38, and ER-2 aircraft. Learn how to secure your spot on the flightline: https://www.nasa.gov/maxpower/ | NASA - National Aeronautics and Space Administration
